o: While the world recovers from the global catastrophe of last season, a changed Mark struggles with guilt as he fights to protect his home and the people he loves, setting him on a collision course with a powerful new threat that could alter the fate of humanity forever.

eps.t: MAKING THE WORLD A BETTER PLACE
eps.o: Mark battles enemies new and old in his fight to keep Earth safe.

eps.t: I'LL GIVE YOU THE GRAND TOUR
eps.o: Loyalties are challenged when an old enemy is revealed.
